world.scene_additions: vision, caregiver, mobile and critters off for this build (BridgeEnv defaults; the released run had mobile on, critters on, caregiver_mode responsive): they add joints (nq 121 here against 146 in the released run's observer headers, weights/b1_continue_B1K_skip13_492800/run/observer/world/b0/header_*.json) and no skin; the digest is the released worlds' (mimo_bridge/touch_inside_rays.py:24-25)

search.weight: max(1 - distance / (2 * force_spread_scale_m), 0), normalised to sum 1; when no point is in range, or every point in range lies at 2 * force_spread_scale_m or further (all weights 0), the single nearest live point gets weight 1 (contact_mechanics.py:71-74)

units.positions_m: metres in the body frame (MIMo geom_pos_to_body at the build pose, touch.py:890)
units.scale_m: metres between neighbouring sensor points (touch_params scales x touch_scale_mult)

digest_rule: first 16 hex characters of sha256 over the live points' float64 [x, y, z] bytes, bodies in id order, points in each body's output order (mimo_bridge/touch_inside_rays.py:126-131)

placeholder_bodies.rule: sensing bodies whose scale_m is at least SKIN_SCALE_MAX 0.5 m form no patch (mimo_bridge/touch_adapter.py:68, 190) and are outside the digest
